text: Kaa ko hommbo tagi kammuuli ɗin e leydi ndin ko aldaa e misal aditiingal, O jippinani on -onon yimɓe ɓen- immorde ka kammu ndiyam toɓo ngon, Men fuɗinirani on ngo gese moƴƴuɗi ŋari, laatanataaka on fuɗinngol leɗɗe ɗin naakooji sabu ronkugol mooɗon, ko Alla woni fuɗinƊo ɗe On. Enee, hara ko reweteeɗo goo waɗi ɗun wonndude e Alla?! Wanaa non, ko woni, kamɓe ko yimɓe seluɓe Goonga kan hiɓe fotindira Taguɗo On e tagaaɓe ɓen e hoore tooñe.
